outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the handle and pulls the door outward: frames 80–100 show the handle separating from the oven body and the door tilting open in image and left_ego_image. The door remains visibly ajar through frame 171 in image, with its projecting edge also visible in wrist_image. The task does not specify a fully lowered door; opening is visibly achieved without an established failed attempt or unintended side effect.
